name: store-studio
description: Manage App Store Connect and Google Play from Claude Code: upload, reorder and download screenshots for every locale and device, edit store text, upload builds (.ipa on a Mac, .aab anywhere) with staged rollouts, manage TestFlight, and reach every other endpoint of both official APIs (versions, review submissions, phased releases, pricing, reviews, analytics and sales reports, tracks, Data safety) through reference lookup, reads and confirmed writes. Up to three App Store Connect teams and three Play accounts, set up in the plugin settings with your own API keys; keys stay in your system's secure storage.

app_store_key_id.title: App Store Connect: key ID
app_store_key_id.description: Key ID of a Team API key (App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API). The App Manager role covers listings, screenshots, versions, builds and TestFlight.

app_store_issuer_id.title: App Store Connect: issuer ID
app_store_issuer_id.description: The Issuer ID shown above the keys list on the same page.

app_store_private_key.title: App Store Connect: private key
app_store_private_key.description: Open the AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 file you downloaded in a text editor, copy all of it (including the BEGIN and END lines) and paste it here. It is kept in your system's secure storage.

app_store_name.title: App Store Connect: account name (optional)
app_store_name.description: A short name for this team, such as acme, so you can tell accounts apart.

app_store_2_key_id.title: App Store Connect account 2: key ID
